pendentes.titulo: Selo 80 Plus: o que muda de Bronze para Gold na fonte do PC
pendentes.alt: Fonte de alimentação de computador sobre uma bancada de madeira, com cabos modulares enrolados ao lado
pendentes.pedido: A generic black ATX computer power supply unit resting on a clean light wooden workbench, viewed from a three-quarter angle so the fan grille is visible. A few black modular cables are neatly coiled next to it. An open desktop case without side panel stands blurred in the background. Soft natural daylight from a window on the left, shallow depth of field, realistic product-style photograph.

pendentes.titulo: iOS 18.7.11: atualização fecha falha explorada em iPhone XS e XR
pendentes.alt: Smartphone antigo deitado de costas sobre uma mesa de madeira, ao lado de um cabo de carregador enrolado
pendentes.pedido: An older smartphone lying face down on a light wooden table, its glossy back facing up with no visible logo, seen from a low angle. A coiled white charging cable rests beside it. A ceramic mug is out of focus in the background. Soft natural daylight from a window on the right.
